_comment: The 9 Marks docs/04-upgrades.md §4.5 names explicitly, out of '25
Marks total... ...16 more' - the doc itself leaves the other sixteen
'implemented: false' Marks are real, catalogued content with no live
effect yet - each has its own specific, checked reason in
'balanceNote'. Unlock-condition checking ('earnedBy') is not built for
ANY Mark yet, implemented or not - see ADR 0095.

marks.name: Mark of the Unbroken
marks.earnedBy: Clear a chapter without taking damage
marks.balanceNote: Deferred - see ADR 0095. Needs a player-HP-conditional damage channel ("while at full HP") that does not exist - the closest existing conditionals are all enemy-HP-scoped (vsWounded, vsDying).

marks.name: Mark of the Choir
marks.balanceNote: Deferred - see ADR 0095. Needs a boss-scoped damage channel that does not exist, the same gap ADR 0092 found for the Spire's own Iron Resolve.

marks.name: Mark of the Ninefold
marks.balanceNote: Deferred - see ADR 0095. boonCardCount is read from BoonInventory.stats directly (boon_pool.dart), not world.combat - the same Wing-IV-style integration gap ADR 0092 found for the Spire's own economy nodes.
